contract.title: TWIN-43 AP/VMware 921600 波特率统一与全栈一键编译及配置化启动脚本
contract.accepted_scope: Software and POSIX PTY sandbox verification of 921600/460800/115200 baud support, invalid-baud rejection, manifest schema validation, and deploy_twin.sh full CLI/config lifecycle (--build-only, --config non-default loading and CLI override precedence, --mode sim and PTY-backed --mode hardware launch, missing-UART preflight, post-launch health-check failure cleanup, and recovery). Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable: qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-04 VMware运行时构建与services_manifest.json配置基线
继承TWIN-30 VMware全流程闭环与串口通信基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；组件自检；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

positive_cases: SerialConfig与QueryOptions默认波特率统一为921600，services_manifest.json中ap_mc_uart.baud_rate统一为921600并通过validate_schemas.py校验

deploy_twin.sh读取默认config/runtime/vmware/aisoc_twin.conf（全部7个配置键100%被消费，无冗余未生效配置键）与自定义--config配置文件(460800/18082)，CLI参数(--baud 921600 --port 18083)优先级高于配置文件，支持--build-only、--mode sim、基于PTY的--mode hardware、--status、--stop、--help及重复启停恢复生命周期
negative_cases: 传入非法波特率（123456）时serial_open立即返回false并拒绝打开串口（fd==-1且is_open==false），soc-ap CLI、deploy_twin.sh传入--baud 123456、非法--mode、非法--port、未知CLI选项或不存在的--config文件时均报错并以非0退出码拒绝执行
hardware模式下当指定AISOC_UART_DEVICE（/dev/nonexistent_ttyUSB99）不存在时以非0退出码终止且不降级启动sim进程；当守护进程启动后健康探活失败（FORCE_CURL_FAIL=1）时自动逆序停止全部已启动守护进程并清理全部PID/runtime.env文件，随后重新启动可正常恢复
